text:
Ivy: Heads up, spotted a small but clear double-charge pattern on the canary. Looks like retry + region fallback + truncated stream.
Marco: any traces/ids?
Ivy: trace trc-03, snippet below (sanitized).
Ivy: ```
2026-03-24T09:01:02Z trace=trc-03 req=rz-900 route=us-east-1 client_session=cs-900 toolcall_id=tc-333 provisional_tokens=800 truncated_at=795
2026-03-24T09:01:06Z client retried -> routed to ap-northeast-1 req=rz-900 client_session=cs-900 toolcall_id= (none) provisional_tokens=800
2026-03-24T09:01:12Z ledger: both provisional -> confirmed -> billed 1600 tokens
```
Tara: That fits the known hole: we only dedupe on toolcall_id. If retry drops idempotency header and gets routed elsewhere, ledger treats as independent.
Marco: Is this specific to tool responses?
Ivy: Toolcalls expose it more because responses are long and truncation/retry is common. Plain streaming can also trigger it though.
Tara: Short-term ops: 1) add alert for sudden rise in "confirmed_tokens / provisional_tokens" per route, 2) run a reconciliation query that finds same client_session+req within 30s across routes and mark suspects for billing-ops.
Marco: Long-term: introduce propagated flow id header (proposal: X-RW-Flow-Id). Gateway should assign on ingress and copy when rerouting so downstream ledgers can use it as primary dedupe key.
Ivy: We should also emit provisional_origin metadata (route, host, flow_id) and confirmed_origin on ledger events so console can show where provisional->confirmed diverged.
Tara: Alternative heuristic at ledger: if flow-id missing, dedupe on (client_session, model, prompt_hash) within short TTL as a fallback. But only flag as suspect, don't auto-refund.
Marco: Agree. Heuristic can reduce noise but must not silently undercharge. Manual or semi-auto reconcile preferred.
Ivy: Owners? Marco -> gateway + header propagation (feature-flagged canary). Tara -> telemetry + console panel for "provisional leakage". I'll coordinate billing-ops for reconcile.
ops-bot: created ticket BLG-2026-88 and pinged @billing-ops (auto)
Marco: I'll add unit + e2e tests simulating truncation -> retry across regions with/without flow-id. Also add a canary metric for "requests_missing_idempotency_pct".
Tara: I'll add provisional_origin tags to spans and a dashboard widget that filters sessions with provisional!=confirmed in last 24h.
Ivy: For immediate mitigation, I recommend turning on a Grafana alert with threshold: confirmed_tokens_by_route / provisional_tokens_by_route > 1.5 over 5m.
Marco: noted. I'll also make the gateway copy header by default in the canary and keep it behind a flag.
Tara: Will open PRs for telemetry + console today. Ivy, please drop any more traces into this thread if you spot them.
Ivy: Will do. Thanks — let's reconvene after PRs land to verify dashboard numbers. :raised_hands:
